test_cut: test the polars Series.cut() method to bin numeric values into categorical intervals
test_cut_lazy_schema: test the polars LazyFrame column expression cut() method preserves correct Categorical schema
test_cut_include_breaks: test the polars Series.cut() method with include_breaks to return both breakpoint and category columns
test_cut_null_values: test the polars Series.cut() method correctly handles null values by returning None for NaN entries
test_cut_fast_unique: test the polars Series.cut() method returns correct unique count for categorical bin labels
